newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Davids' Patten resigns due to ill health.
newsitem.headline: Davids' Patten resigns due to ill health.

text.p: Food wholesaler and retailer Davids Ltd said on Monday that joint managing director John Patten had resigned due to ill health.
"Following Mr Patten's resignation, the company has made a number of major organisational and management changes," Davids said in a statement.

Jeff David, formerly joint managing director, has been appointed managing director. Don Bourke has joined Davids to aid the further rationalisation and integration of Davids recent acquisitions, the company said.
Bourke would also act as chief financial officer while the company concludes the search for an experienced finance executive, Davids said.
Davids also said it would amalgamate its Jewel and Davids distributions divisions into a new division, Retail Distribution, which will have a gross sales turnover of around A$5 billion.
Bob Neslund, previously chief executive officer of Jewel Food Stores, has been appointed managing director of the new division.
